{"CommandLine":"cat << 'EOF' >> scratch.lean

theorem minCard_le {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (p : Finset V → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (s : Finset V) (hs : p s) :
    GraphCalc.minCard p ≤ s.card := by
  unfold GraphCalc.minCard
  let img := ((Finset.univ.powerset.filter p).image Finset.card)
  have h_mem : s.card ∈ img := by
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨s, ?_, rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (Finset.subset_univ s), hs⟩
  have h_min_le : img.min ≤ (s.card : WithTop ℕ) := Finset.min_le h_mem
  cases heq : img.min with
  | top =>
    rw [heq] at h_min_le
    contradiction
  | coe m =>
    have : (m : WithTop ℕ) ≤ (s.card : WithTop ℕ) := by
      rw [heq] at h_min_le
      exact h_min_le
    have h_le : m ≤ s.card := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp this
    show (some m : Option ℕ).getD 0 ≤ s.card
    exact h_le
EOF
